title: Server Tour video
body:
A server tour of Disorder of the Stone is up on the afk YouTube channel:

![video: Minecraft: Disorder of the Stone - Server Tour]({{links.video_server_tour}})

* Disorder of the Stone will be playable
* There is no release date yet, but work continues to get it out as soon as possible
* When it is finished, it will be available on Modrinth only
* Please don't ask anyone listed in the credits for early access
